= spatial.removeLayer

:description: This section contains reference documentation for the spatial.removeLayer procedure.

label:procedure[]

[.emphasis]
Removes the given layer. Deletes the nodes the layer created (e.g. by `spatial.addWKT`); nodes added with `spatial.addNode` are only removed from the index

== Signature

[source]
----
spatial.removeLayer(name :: STRING)
----

== Input parameters

[.procedures,opts=header,cols='1,1,1,7']
|===
|Name|Type|Default|Description
|name|STRING|null
a|The name of the layer
|===
